compute_google_bleu_score: compute corpus-level Google BLEU (GLEU) score of translated segments against references
test_GoogleBleu_compute: test the GoogleBleu compute method with predictions and references lists
review_GoogleBleu_info: review the GoogleBleu info method that returns metric metadata and features
build_google_bleu_metric: build a Google BLEU metric using evaluate.load for machine translation evaluation
summarize_GoogleBleu_compute: summarize the GoogleBleu compute method with custom min_len and max_len n-gram parameters
